compiled:
📰 General

Winter Storm Intensifies, Bringing More Snow and Dangerous Cold to Millions •

A significant winter storm is currently impacting tens of millions of Americans, with forecasts predicting further snowfall. The storm’s rapid intensification coincides with already hazardous conditions, having contributed to over 100 deaths across the country in the past week. Officials report widespread travel disruptions and power outages due to the severe weather. The storm’s continued presence is expected to exacerbate existing challenges for communities already dealing with the extreme cold.

🌍 World

Hamas Planned Decade-Long Hostage Strategy, Former Israeli General Reveals •

Former Brig.-Gen. (res.) Gal Hirsch detailed Hamas’s strategy involving the prolonged detention of Israeli hostages. Hirsch stated the group intended to hold captives for up to ten years, utilizing them as a strategic tool for negotiation. He described this tactic as a “long game” involving both living and deceased hostages. The interview, published in The Post, outlines a previously undisclosed element of Hamas’s operational planning.

🦅 US

Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom Face Off: AI Chip Leaders Dominate 2026 Forecast •

The article examines the leading chip companies – Nvidia, AMD, and Broadcom – within the burgeoning artificial intelligence market. All three firms are positioned as strong investments due to their involvement in the production of chips crucial for AI development and deployment. Nvidia currently holds a significant lead due to its established market position and technological advancements. AMD and Broadcom are also considered key players, benefiting from increasing demand for AI-related processing solutions.

💰 Business

Nvidia CEO Denies Reports of Stalled $100 Billion OpenAI Investment •

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang refuted reports of significant friction regarding the company’s substantial investment in OpenAI. Huang’s statement, made on Saturday, directly addressed a Wall Street Journal article detailing a planned scaling back of the investment. The report indicated a shift in Nvidia’s strategy concerning its partnership with OpenAI, which Huang characterized as “nonsense.” Nvidia continues to be a major investor and strategic partner with OpenAI, focusing on AI chip development.

💻 Technology

Highguard Adds Limited-Time 5v5 Mode – Available This Weekend Only •

Wildlight has released an update for the hero shooter Highguard, introducing a new 5v5 game mode. This limited-time mode will be exclusively available to players this weekend. The update also includes a new map, Soul Well, designed for the 5v5 format. Players can access the 5v5 mode through the game’s live service.

🎭 Entertainment

Grady Demond Wilson, ‘Sanford and Son’ Star, Passes Away at 79 •

Grady Demond Wilson, the actor who portrayed Lamont Sanford in the iconic television series “Sanford and Son,” died at his home in California. He was 79 years old at the time of his death, confirmed by The New York Times. Wilson’s son, Christopher Wilson, indicated that his father had recently been working on a book about his life and career. The actor’s role as Lamont Sanford was a significant part of the show’s comedic success during the 1970s.

🏅 Sports

BYU Faces Kansas in Big 12 Showdown Featuring Rising NBA Prospect •

The BYU Cougars are set to compete against the Kansas Jayhawks in a Big 12 basketball game on Saturday. The contest features a matchup between potential NBA draft lottery picks, including BYU freshman AJ Dybantsa. Dybantsa is making his first appearance in college basketball, generating significant attention. The game will be held in Lawrence, Kansas, and will be closely monitored by scouts.

🔬 Science

Citizen Scientist’s Discovery Sparks Intense Focus on New Earth-Like Planet •

A citizen scientist, Alexander Venner, identified a potentially habitable exoplanet orbiting a distant star. Using data from the Parkes Observatory in Australia, Venner noticed a peculiar signal indicating the presence of a planet remarkably similar to Earth. Astrophysicists are now prioritizing the use of powerful telescopes, including the James Webb Space Telescope, to further investigate the planet’s atmosphere and composition. Initial observations suggest the planet resides within its star’s habitable zone, raising hopes for the possibility of liquid water.

🩺 Health

Blood Test Shows Promise in Detecting Parkinson’s Decades Before Symptoms Appear •

Researchers at Chalmers University of Technology and Oslo University Hospital have identified specific biomarkers in blood that could indicate the presence of Parkinson’s disease many years before clinical symptoms manifest. The study focused on identifying unique protein signatures present in individuals with early-stage Parkinson’s, suggesting a potential for early detection. Analysis of blood samples revealed these biomarkers were detectable up to 30 years prior to the onset of motor symptoms, offering a significant advancement in understanding the disease’s progression. This discovery could pave the way for preventative measures and targeted therapies for individuals at risk.
